description: Shopify to Google Merchant Center mapping for the per-country primary feed. build_primary_feed.py reads this file; the app UI will display it. Transform names refer to functions in build_primary_feed.py.

fields.rule: shopify_<country>_<product id>_<variant id>
Product title, then ", variant title" unless the variant is the default; cut at 150 characters
Whitespace collapsed, cut at 5000 characters; falls back to the title
That country's store URL + /products/<handle>?variant=<variant id>, so the page shows the same price
Copied as is
Up to 10, comma separated
in_stock when available, else out_of_stock
Shopify's own price for the country, in that country's currency, 2 decimals; the run stops if the currency differs from the expected one
Copied as is
Copied as is
Always new
Copied as is, groups the variants of one product
Looked up in product_type by the prefix before the first underscore

fields.shopify: variant option: Material Option, else Material
fields.rule: Karat with gold colour, e.g. 14k Solid Yellow Gold; the colour comes from the option, then the product title, then the URL handle, then the YG code in the SKU (bare karats only)
Yellow Gold, White Gold, Rose Gold or Platinum; empty when the metal colour is unknown

fields.shopify: variant option: Bar Length, else Ball Size
fields.rule: Brackets removed, bare numbers get mm, e.g. 10mm
Fixed value, set only when a Google category matches
Fixed value, set only when a Google category matches
Looked up in google_category by the prefix before the first underscore; empty when no match
Always false until Google UCP onboarding is complete
